771020701.text: The bridge to the assembly hall is right over there. But where is Furiosa? I usually see her around here...

771020702.text: Hmm... Is this "Furiosa" someone really important, Nastya? Paimon's heard you mention her quite a few times now.

771020703.text: Of course! She's my idol! Or should I say, she's still my number-one idol right now, and you two are at number two for now.

771020704.text: You should have a match-up with her when you have the time! Maybe the rankings will change then!

771020706.text: #Aw, yeah! {NICKNAME} is a super good fighter, you know!

771020709.text: But Paimon gets it now: Nastya likes people who are good at fighting. The stronger, the better!

771020710.text: No, no, Paimonka, you got it all wrong. I like people who can protect others. That's why I like Furiosa, Zala, the Doctor, and the two of you too!

771020711.text: It's just that the stronger you are, the more people you can protect... I think that's why Furiosa said yes to growing branches!

771020712.text: ...They say she was the first person in town to grow branches. After the Doctor helped her grow them, she got new, stronger arms, and she became even better at fighting.

771020713.text: After that, everyone started spending most of their time at the assembly hall, while she stayed outside to keep us safe...

771020708.text: Hey, hey, hey — why are you thinking of turning tail even before the match-up has happened??? Paimon totally believes in you!

771020801.text: She's gone... We can enter the assembly hall now!

771020803.text: Nastya? What is it? We're almost at your home, aren't we...?

771020804.text: I just don't understand... Why did Furiosa try to stop me... and why hasn't she turned into the Perfect Tree yet?

771020201.text: Huh? Why isn't anything happening? Is the switch broken because it hasn't been used in really long or something?

771020202.text: Hmm, I think there's another switch on the other side. The curtain should open if we use both switches at the same time.

771020203.text: Tell you what, Paimon's gonna fly over there, and you two stay here and activate this switch...

771020206.text: Hey! Paimon's stronger than you think, okay! It's just a tiny switch... Mmgh... Ugh... The switch must be jammed!

771020207.text: #I'll give Paimonka a hand. The two of us together should be as good as one {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}.

771020208.text: Can we do it...? Hold on... Let's do it together... One, two, three!

771020209.text: Yes!!! We did it! Nastya and Paimon will stay on this side. You go over to the other side, and when Paimon gives the signal, we'll activate the mechanisms at the same time...

771020210.text: Aye, aye. Ready for your orders, Captain!

771020211.text: Let's see... We should be able to get through from over there.

771020212.text: #Be careful now, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}! That way looks dangerous! You haven't grown any branches yet, so it'll really hurt if you fall!

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to get inside the assembly hall.

771020301.text: #Alright, think that does it! Ooh, there's an elevator here. Let's meet up with {NICKNAME} downstairs.

771020101.text: It's not opening from this side... or from this side either...

771020102.text: #Paimonka, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, we usually go through this door in the middle, but I think it's now locked from the inside...

771020103.text: Looks like we can get in through here.

771020104.text: Hmm, I think... I can squeeze in through here? Wait for me. I'll go open the door.

771020105.text: Okay! Just call out to us if you run into any trouble, Nastya. Paimon can squeeze through to help too!

subQuests.subQuestName: Wait for Nastya to open the door

771020501.text: Phew... I'm just glad everyone's okay! I didn't know we were gonna find so many people here... behind the shelves.

771020502.text: Same... One second it was dead quiet, and the next, BOOM! They just came rushing out like that!

771020503.text: But hey, look at that new path that just opened up over here.

771020504.text: It looks like the way home to me.

771020505.text: I don't know about that. But looks like it's the only path now, and the Doctor said before, "The only path is the right path."

771020506.text: So as long as I follow this path, I'm sure I'll make it back to mama and turn into the Perfect Tree...

771020507.text: The Doctor should be home too. He's never gonna leave. Zala is protecting him, so I know he's there.

771020508.text: Looks like we're close to finding the answer...

771020509.text: Let's keep going, then... Once we get to your "home" and meet Koshchei... no, Paimon means that "Doctor Moreau," we should finally get the answers we've been looking for.

771021402.text: Yeah. It's so pretty, isn't it? ...But sometimes, I don't really like it here.

771021403.text: When we're here, we have to hold the little booklets Doctor Moreau wrote while we listen to him tell his stories... The grown-ups would all listen really carefully, so we aren't allowed to talk either.

771021404.text: But I don't always understand Doctor Moreau's stories. Sometimes, I'd secretly fall asleep, or just sit there thinking about nothing, or look at everything around me.

771021405.text: That's why I know this place pretty well... Huh? Why do some parts look different than before? Let me think...

771021406.text: Oh, that's right! The curtain here, it's closed! We have to get behind it... I remember there's a path on the other side.

771021407.text: Hey, look! That mechanism over there looks like it's connected to the curtain!

771021408.text: Wow, you're really good at spotting stuff! That should be it. Let's go do it together! But it's so high up... I can't reach it...

771021409.text: You can wait for us here, Nastya.

771021410.text: ...No, no. I want to go with you. Family is supposed to stay together.

771021411.text: Please let me come along... Don't worry, I'll stick real close, just like Paimonka...

771021412.text: Um, okay. Hold on just a second while we think of something.

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to move the curtain
Go to the other curtain switch

771020901.text: #Huh? Is {NICKNAME} already on the other side???

771020902.text: #Then Paimon must yell really, really loudly so that {M#he}{F#she} can hear Paimon clearly!

subQuests.subQuestName: Activate both switches at the same time
Activate both switches at the same time

771021101.text: Can we go up there and activate the switch together now?

771020601.text: I remember this was carved to look like Zala. But Zala doesn't look like this anymore.

771020602.text: We have to keep going, through here...

771020603.text: Oh, okay! Onward we go~ Hang on, isn't this just a wall?

771020604.text: This is the doorway to home. Only the ones who are chosen can go through and become eternal life free of all worries.

771020605.text: Doctor Moreau is the only one who's supposed to know how to open this door, but... But one time, I saw how he did it when I was hiding in a corner of the hall...

771020606.text: Nastya draws a simple diagram and hands it to you.

771020607.text: Hmm, so this thing is actually a dial. To open the door behind it, we have to turn it to match the right pattern...

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the door leading to "home"

771021501.text: The dial isn't doing anything... Uh, is the mechanism here broken?

771021502.text: ...Oh! I remember now! For the last step, we gotta put the "salt" there.

771021503.text: Doctor Moreau said that for a person to turn into the Perfect Tree, they have to change in three ways...

771021504.text: "Cast off the soul of the past, and it shall no longer be bound by the hidden veins of the earth." Then, the thing that replaces the soul of the past is... the um... s—sulfur of the soul?

771021505.text: "Cast off the will of the past, and it shall no longer be watched by the gaze above." And the thing that replaces the will is the silver of the spirit.

771021506.text: The last thing you have to cast off is... "Cast off the body of the past, and it shall no longer be worn away by the toil and turmoil of the mortal world." So at this point, we have to offer up the material that will replace the body.

771021507.text: So uh... The salt is... the new body that grows from the old one. Yes, that's it!

771021508.text: Ow... This hurts a little more than I thought.

771021510.text: I'm okay. It hurts a lot, but I'm happy. This way, I can go back home, and you can find the Doctor and ask him about Koshchei.

771021511.text: So this little bit of hurt doesn't matter... Hurry, hurry up and offer up the salt.

771021512.text: #...Uh, okay, sure. We'll do as you say. {NICKNAME}, let's put this little branch on that platform.

771021601.text: Hmm... Once we go through the doorway, we're at home. But...

771021603.text: N-Nothing. I don't know why, but my heart feels a little messy, like a pile of fallen leaves...

771021604.text: The doctor once said that "the closer you get to home, the more nervous you feel.” I never understood it back then, but now I think I get it...

771021701.text: After finding a suitable spot, Nastya tosses over the items she just found to you...

subQuests.subQuestName: Cover Nastya so she can get closer

771020401.text: Oh yeah... the day the Volkodlak took us away, all of us kids were told to go to the assembly hall. My... My friends were probably here too...

771020402.text: It's been so long since I saw them.

771020405.text: Same here. Then we must hurry.

771020407.text: You're amazing! I haven't found anything yet. I need to try harder!

771021301.text: But where is Furiosa? I usually see her around here... I really wanna to see her!

771021302.text: Hmm... Is Furiosa very important to you, Nastya?

771021303.text: Of course! She's my idol! Or should I say, she's still my number-one idol right now, and you two are now at number two.

771021304.text: But that ranking's just for now. If you ever get a chance to spar someday, maybe that ranking will change!

771021306.text: #That's right, that's right! {NICKNAME} is a super good fighter, you know!

771021309.text: But Paimon gets it now: Nastya likes people who are good at fighting. The stronger, the better!

771021310.text: No, no, Paimonka, you got it all wrong. I like people who can protect others. That's why I like Furiosa, Anka, the Doctor, and the two of you too!

771021311.text: It's just that the stronger you are, the more people you can protect... I think that's why Furiosa said yes to growing branches!

771021312.text: ...They say she was the first person in town to grow branches. After the Doctor helped her grow them, all the problems she had went away... And she became even better at fighting.

771021313.text: After that, everyone started spending most of their time at the assembly hall, while she stayed outside to keep us safe...

771021314.text: So you want to keep more people safe too, Nastya? Is that why you want to grow leaves and branches too?

771021315.text: Um... I never really thought about it like that... I mean, I'm so small. Even if I got stronger, I still won't be that strong. All I want is to be just like everyone else in the family...

771021316.text: Hmm, if we do see Furiosa later, I wonder if she'll still know who I am...

771021317.text: Oh, she definitely will! ...Hold on, what if she's like Anka!? What if she thinks we're Badbugs, stomps all over us, and burns us to a crisp!?

771021318.text: Mmm, don't worry about that. Furiosa will still spar with you even if you aren't Badbugs.

771021319.text: And burning Badbugs isn't her job... So even if she really thinks you two are Badbugs, you should be fine.

771021308.text: Hey, hey, hey — why are you thinking of turning tail even before the fight has happened??? Paimon totally believes in you!

771021201.text: #What is it, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}? Is something wrong?

771021203.text: No need to worry. I'll protect Paimonka, and Paimonka will protect me.

771021204.text: A little tree will be blown over by the wind, but two little trees can lean on each other.

771021206.text: Okay. We'll be waiting for you.
